reasoning: The icon depicts three vertical bars of different heights, universally recognized as a bar chart, statistics, or analytics. It fits many common tasks across work, finance, tech, and education involving charts, metrics, and data analysis, though it shares visual similarity with audio equalizers and cellular signal bars.

pass1.ambiguity: Can be confused with an audio equalizer, volume bars, cellular signal bars (though those usually ascend left-to-right), or a Kanban board column icon.
